section3.title: 3. Workplace Evaluation
section3.subtitle: Rate each of the ten criteria below based on your observation of the workplace.
section3.asterisk_note: * Any "Somewhat disagree" or "Strongly disagree" rating must be explained in the Comments section.

criteres.TACHES_CONFORMES: The tasks assigned to the intern match the tasks stated in the internship agreement.
criteres.MESURES_ACCUEIL: Onboarding measures facilitate the integration of the new intern.
criteres.TEMPS_ENCADREMENT_SUFFISANT: The actual time devoted to supervising the intern is sufficient.
criteres.ENVIRONNEMENT_SECURITAIRE: The work environment complies with occupational health and safety standards.
criteres.ACCESSIBLE_TRANSPORT_COMMUN: The workplace is accessible by public transit.
criteres.SALAIRE_INTERESSANT: The salary offered is attractive for the intern.
criteres.COMMUNICATION_SUPERVISEUR: Communication with the internship supervisor facilitates the internship.
criteres.EQUIPEMENT_ADEQUAT: The equipment provided is adequate to carry out the assigned tasks.
